'''Arkhan Brem'tu''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] he was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Bothawui Defense Corps]]. He opposed the rise of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and played a role in the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Special Operations]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] he was involved with operations at the [[Takeover at Whisper Base|captured]] [[Whisper Base]].
